name: Furrow Racer
text: Both Ends. Whenever the other end of your pair pricks an attacker, give your units in this row +1 Attack this combat.
golden_text: Both Ends. Whenever the other end of your pair pricks an attacker, give your units in this row +1 Attack this combat.

source.note: Both Ends: while you have a Both Ends unit in F1 and another in F4 (or B1 and B3), each has +1/+2. Whenever an enemy attacks one of the pair, the other first deals 2 damage to the attacker; if that kills it, the attack doesn't happen.
